fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of the road.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive to maintain clear vehicle width for emergency apparatus.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency apparatus to reach the main residence without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation where it crowds the main residence to allow responders to move around the structure on foot.
• Mark or post the address visibly at the front entry area to confirm location during an approach.
• Keep a gate, path, or opening available at the rear or side of the property so responders can reach the back of the main residence on foot.
• Post or mark the location of the detached structure at the driveway entrance so arriving responders are aware of a second building on the property.
• Keep a clear walking path between the main residence and the detached structure free of stored items or overgrown vegetation.
• Identify and maintain a flat, firm area near the access drive that emergency vehicles can use to park or turn around without blocking the drive.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back shrubs and low-growing plants that are touching or within a few feet of the exterior walls on all sides of the structure.
• Thin the dense tree cluster nearest to the structure to create open space between individual trees and between the trees and the building.
• Thin the second tree cluster to reduce the concentration of trees and create gaps between the canopies.
• Remove dead branches and low limbs from large trees near the structure, cutting them back to a height that keeps them well clear of the roofline and walls.
• Remove any shrubs, brush, or plant material growing directly beneath the scattered trees closest to the structure.
• Clear any vegetation, branches, or debris that has accumulated along the sides of the driveway to keep the travel surface fully passable.
• Keep overhanging branches trimmed back so they do not obstruct vehicle height clearance along the driveway.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to locate from the road, particularly under low visibility conditions.
• Clear a path around the rear of the structure wide enough for a person to walk through without obstruction, using it to remove any brush or debris blocking that area.
• Because there is only one way in and out, keep the full length of the access route clear of vegetation, parked vehicles, and debris at all times.
